verdict.rationale: Dispute handling is a fair axis for a payments platform like Flutterwave, so it applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions disputes or chargebacks, or any API to retrieve disputes, attach evidence, or submit responses. The docs cover payments, transfers, FX, OTPs and subscriptions only, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
